amended_interpretation_20260822.authorized_framing: A complete in-distribution ground-truth history recovers rho = 0.515/0.320 (cell G, windows 2/3) and 0.506/0.314 (cell N) of the gap to the ground-truth-conditioned window 1, i.e. +0.199 to +0.229 slope units with all four paired-bootstrap 95 percent CIs excluding zero. Compounding of a degraded history is therefore a real, measured contributor and rho is its size. The residual is the larger share: 0.485 of the window-2 gap and 0.680 of the window-3 gap survive a perfect history, and that residual per-window contraction is the main problem.
corroborating_facts_independent_of_the_E: window 1 already contracts from b = 1.025 at the first generated frame to b = 0.899 over its own 42 frames, from a ground-truth start with nothing accumulated
b_TF(w3) = 0.414 is far below b_TF(w2) = 0.708 although BOTH windows consumed a complete ground-truth history, so part of the depth dependence is not history quality at all
amended_interpretation_20260822.remedy_reading_is_a_bound_not_an_exclusi: Scheduled sampling or rollout fine-tuning may capture the rho fraction, but on this evidence their ceiling is the teacher-forced slope itself (b = 0.708/0.414 against b_ref = 0.899), so they cannot be the whole remedy and must not be the only next training direction. The earlier wording 'predicted NOT to fix the contraction' is replaced by this bound.
amended_interpretation_20260822.ruling: User ruling 2026-08-22: record P14 as teacher forcing PARTIALLY improving height tracking while the residual per-window height contraction remains the main problem. Do NOT record it as exposure bias being absent.
amended_interpretation_20260822.superseded_wording: The phrases 'intrinsic to the conditioning mechanism, not exposure bias', 'Exposure bias is ruled OUT as the dominant mechanism' and 'does NOT restore height-keeping ability ... leaves the per-window contraction untouched' overstate the result. lambda is a secondary discriminator; it bounds the exposure-bias mechanism's share and cannot establish that the mechanism is absent.
amended_interpretation_20260822.unchanged: No measured value in this record is altered and the PRIMARY classification stays tf-partial. Reframed reading surfaces: docs/HOIPRIOR_EVIDENCE_INDEX.md conclusion 23 and docs/phase_summaries/PHASE_1B_P14_ROLLOUT_TEACHER_FORCING.md.
amended_interpretation_20260822.what_lambda_establishes: lambda 0.018-0.045 establishes that the model's response slope is nearly the same whether the history level is ground truth or its own drifted output, so a clean history does not repair the per-window contraction. It does NOT establish that the exposure-bias mechanism contributes nothing; the measured rho is that contribution's size.

headline: A COMPLETE ground-truth history does NOT restore height-keeping ability. It removes the compounding (worth rho ~ 0.51 at window 2) and leaves the per-window contraction untouched: the model response slope to an in-distribution ground-truth history is indistinguishable from its response slope to its own degraded output (lambda 0.018-0.045).
manipulated_factor: the history source for rollout windows 2 and 3 only (model own output -> that window world-frame ground truth, all five history channels)
next_action: Record that the per-window height contraction is intrinsic to the conditioning mechanism, not exposure bias, so the remedy class that treats it as exposure bias (scheduled sampling, rollout fine-tuning) is predicted to fail and should not be the next training run. The contraction is a property of how the model consumes an absolute-height history, which makes it load-bearing for the HOSI long-horizon chaining design: at b=0.19 by window 3, subject identity is already gone inside the released protocol own horizon. W3 geometry-term training stays on hold until the corrected P6 cell-U re-measurement lands.
non_claims: The teacher-forced arms 18 protocol metrics are NOT model scores and must never appear in /data/yujinlun/report/baseline.md, the evidence-index headline table, or any model comparison. They improve partly because windows 2 and 3 are anchored at the ground-truth location, which is construction, not capability.
The only authorized conclusion form is whether a COMPLETE ground-truth history restores height-keeping ability. It does not.

A recovery may NOT be attributed to the root-y channel alone: all five history channels were substituted. The vertical-only arm that could have isolated it was withdrawn after G4 showed it converts horizontal drift into object-translation error at full magnitude.
This does not reopen the D0 root-y repricing abort and provides no evidence for it.
Exposure bias is ruled OUT as the dominant mechanism, so scheduled sampling and rollout fine-tuning are predicted NOT to fix the contraction. That prediction is itself untested.
Only 3 windows were measured. Extrapolation to the many-window HOSI chain is an extrapolation, not a result.

G4 established that the 232-d conditioning tensor and its derived frame are equivalent between the step-0 and step-N paths. It did NOT cover obj_bps_data, object_goal_batch, pelvis_goal_batch or object_points_batch, so hypothesis F is excluded only for the channels G4 measured.
This says nothing about the frame-0 +2.75/+2.87 cm offset: window 1 is never teacher-forced.
This says nothing about the CHOIS-side deficit.

posthoc_conditional_bound_analysis_20260.authorized_framing: Under the conditional-mean assumption -- that squared-error training drives the model output toward E[y|x] -- the slope obtained by regressing that output on ground truth is constrained by the explainable-variance ceiling of the conditioning the predictor actually uses, so a slope below 1 is not by itself evidence of a defect. Measured against a history-only explainable-variance reference, window 2 under teacher forcing already sits close to that reference, and the large anomaly is concentrated in window 3 and in the normal rollout.
posthoc_conditional_bound_analysis_20260.consequence_that_changes_no_classificati: This record normalizes rho by b_ref = b(w1) = 0.899, while the history-only reference differs across the spans being compared (0.5889 at w1 against 0.7537 at w2 and 0.7154 at w3), so that denominator is not an equal-information yardstick across spans. rho, the confidence intervals and tf-partial are unchanged. What this adds is that at window 2 the residual per-window contraction is smaller relative to what that span's history can explain than the raw gap to 0.899 suggests, and that the deficit is concentrated in window 3 and in the normal rollout.

not_authorized_readings: That the tracking slope IS the R^2 of the conditioning. That must not be written unconditionally: it holds only under the conditional-mean assumption, and window 1 contradicts it at 1.53x the history-only reference.
That the history-only reference is an upper bound on this model. It is not; the model has conditioning beyond the history.

That tf-partial, the PRIMARY readout, or the amended_interpretation_20260822 framing changes. Teacher forcing partially improves height tracking and the residual per-window contraction remains the main problem; that reading stands.
That window 2 is therefore solved. The teacher-forced arm is non-deployable by construction: it consumed a ground-truth history that does not exist at inference.
That any measured value in this record changes. None does.
posthoc_conditional_bound_analysis_20260.status: POST-HOC MECHANISM ANALYSIS, appended 2026-08-22 on user ruling. It is NOT part of the preregistration, NOT a gate, and NOT a re-measurement of this experiment. The PRIMARY readout, the classification tf-partial, every entry of statistics, and every gate verdict are untouched.
posthoc_conditional_bound_analysis_20260.why_this_is_an_assumption_and_not_an_ide: The model is not verified to be a conditional-mean predictor, and one measured value shows the history-only reference is NOT a hard ceiling on it: at window 1 the normal-arm slope is 0.9017 against a history-only reference of 0.5889, i.e. 1.53x the reference. The model conditions on text_embedding, object_bps, goals and progress in addition to the 2-frame history, so its attainable slope is not capped by a history-only figure. This record therefore does NOT assert that the tracking slope IS the R^2 of the conditioning. It asserts only the bounded comparison in authorized_framing, under the stated assumption.
